verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Google Workspace has a pre-integrated SSO app catalog (doc-25 references apps 'not in the pre-integrated catalog', implying one exists) plus a Marketplace for connecting business apps and OIDC-style SSO management, but there is no evidence quantifying catalog breadth (thousands of SAML/OIDC apps) or showing minutes-to-connect setup flows for popular apps; most detailed evidence instead covers custom SAML app configuration and third-party provisioning (e.g., Office 365), which is the opposite of a large pre-built catalog. missing for 10: catalog size/scope documentation, evidence of one-click pre-built integrations for major SaaS apps, independent corroboration of setup speed.
